$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: null and [] explicitly clear lanes
summary: Every lane is required on each snapshot. null or [] explicitly clears a lane; omission never means unchanged. A coaching snapshot with an Instruction, overlays, and actions is followed by an evaluating snapshot whose instruction is null, overlays null, and availableActions [] — the prior instruction, overlays, and actions are cleared atomically.

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

steps.note: coaching with an Instruction, an overlay set, and one available action. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §6.1, §6.4)

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

steps.note: instruction null and overlays null clear the prior Instruction and overlay set; availableActions [] clears the prior action. Activity is required because instruction is null. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §6)

outcome: The phone clears the prior Instruction, overlays, and actions exactly when the next valid snapshot sets those lanes to null/[]; it never carries forward an omitted lane.
